SRC='/home/user/Videos/hogwarts_legacy_spiders.mp4'
W,H,NF = 1920,1080,1158
FPS = 60000/1001.0
PAD = 30

NS = max(ann.keys())

def crest_mask():
    ncc = np.load('/tmp/nccs.npy')
    n = len(ncc)
    on = np.zeros(n, bool)
    lo = ncc > 0.30
    for i in np.where(ncc > 0.60)[0]:
        on[i]=True
        j=i
        while j+1<n and lo[j+1]:
            j+=1; on[j]=True
        j=i
        while j-1>=0 and lo[j-1]:
            j-=1; on[j]=True
    k=5
    on2=on.copy()
    for s in range(1,k+1):
        on2[s:] |= on[:-s]
        on2[:n-s] |= on[s:]
    return on2

CREST_ON = crest_mask()

def boxes_for_frame(f):
    t = f/FPS
    i0 = int(t/0.5)
